## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `gist-verbatim-retention`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-08T22:59:05.110Z.

Planning pass 2026-07-09 (fourth follow-up): Algorithm (15) age-and-value-conditioned verbatim decay with gist-preserving compaction (serves pm-vvib candidate 16 fuzzy-trace dual representation). Purpose: decide WHICH items and WHEN to compress from verbatim to gist so the CORPUS itself stays token-cheap to hold, without ever destroying verbatim or breaking replay — the storage-side dual of read-time packing (9), which selects representation per QUERY. Distinct from (9): (9) chooses a level to SERVE and leaves bytes untouched; (15) chooses bytes to MOVE behind a replayable checkpoint so the default-served layer is smaller for everyone, permanently. Mechanism, three stages. Stage 1 — eligibility scoring (explainable linear form, algorithm 3 weights), computed only for CLOSED, quiescent items so live/open work is never compacted: (a) age since closed_at (needs pm-m4iu; until then falls back to last-history-event ts, never updated_at — the drag-trap field is banned here); (b) quiescence — no reads/retrievals (algorithm 8 sketch retrieval counters from candidate-15 stage 1) and no reconsolidation corrections (candidate 15) in the last K epochs, so precedents under active relitigation stay full-fidelity; (c) verbatim mass — bytes recoverable by compaction (long bodies/comment threads/raw history) so effort targets high-yield items; (d) NEGATIVE weight for structural centrality — items that are frequent analogical precedents (algorithm 10 WL fingerprint hub-ness) or high co-change hubs (algorithm 12) keep verbatim longer because their detail is repeatedly reused. Stage 2 — gist synthesis with provenance: for an eligible item, fold a durable gist digest from the fields fuzzy-trace theory says survive — title, close_reason, resolution, expected/actual, top structural edges, and a bounded extractive summary of the body — and stamp it with a provenance pointer to the exact history-compact checkpoint the verbatim was moved behind. The gist is itself an immutable derived event (write-time fold, algorithm 6); verbatim bytes are relocated by history-compact, NOT deleted, so get --at <version> reconstructs full verbatim on demand and the hash chain still verifies (history-compact's existing replay-integrity guarantee is the substrate; this algorithm only supplies the scheduling policy and the gist payload). Stage 3 — divergence guard (the false-memory detector candidate 16 requires): whenever verbatim is later reconstructed (an agent expands an item), cheaply re-derive the gist from the reconstructed verbatim and compare to the stored gist digest; a mismatch beyond tolerance means the gist drifted from its source (bad summary, or a reconsolidation correction that should have updated the gist but did not) and is surfaced as a validate/health signal keyed to the provenance pointer — never silently trusted. Un-provenanced gist (a digest with no checkpoint pointer) is likewise a hard validate finding. Composes: retrieval funnel (7) serves gist by default; packing (9) prices verbatim expansion as the top representation level; reconsolidation corrections (algorithm 14) attach at the gist layer so they survive compaction; chunking (algorithm 9 rollups) can pack a parent's gist over children's gists for structure-aware compression of compressed items. Spectrum behavior: small/young workspaces have no closed-and-quiescent items so eligibility never fires — one cheap fold per close, zero compaction, full verbatim always; million-item multi-decade workspaces converge to a working set of full-verbatim live/central items plus a long tail of gist-only closed items at a fraction of the bytes, each expandable and hash-verifiable on demand. Cost: O(closed-and-newly-quiescent items per epoch) for eligibility, all folded at write time / gc time (no daemon, ADR pm-i7i4); divergence checks are pay-on-expand, O(1) per reconstruction.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
